analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($333.43) vs SMA5/20/50 ($336.33/$324.35/$309.30) — testing short-term resistance, holding mid-term support
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($288.04/$277.35) — maintaining strong long-term trend
· 52-week position (92.2%) + current price range near historical highs
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (58.1→61.7) — staying neutral, pre-overbought territory
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.7931→0.6416) — weakening, signaling a slowdown in bullish momentum
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $324.35) — band width 12.13%, moderate volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($319.35) — pivot-based support
· Swing resistance ($334.99) — potential for further upside on breakout above short-term resistance
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) — requires confirmation for trend change
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.13x) — normal volume, moderate confidence in price action
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) — consider buying on resistance breakout, selling on support breakdown

analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 매수 판단에서 관망으로 전환. RSI는 58.1에서 61.7로 소폭 상승했으나 여전히 중립 구간이며, MACD 히스토그램이 0.7931에서 0.6416으로 악화된 것이 주요 전환 근거다.
analysis.continuityEn: Shifted from a buy to a hold/watch stance after 3 consecutive prior buy signals. While RSI slightly increased from 58.1 to 61.7, it remains neutral. The primary reason for the shift is the MACD histogram's deterioration from 0.7931 to 0.6416.
